title: A verification by inspection, analysis or demonstration, and its record

schema.description: the schema of this file, from the root of the repo (formats.md, section Schemas)

method.description: how the requirements were verified; a review and a test leave records of their own

confirmed_by.description: who confirmed it - not the one who ran it (PROC-15)

revision.description: the commit the verification ran on

setting.description: the commit that last changed a setting outside the repo it depends on, such as deploy/ruleset-main.json

description.description: the Markdown beside it: requirement, configuration, steps, expected, observed, verdict

observed.description: what happened, with the messages copied, so that they outlast the logs

evidence.description: links and screenshots beside the record
